observations: Single photo shows a flat-screen television leaning against a textured white wall on a tiled/wood floor.
Screen is off/black, highly reflective, showing room reflections (dining table, curtain, doorway).
Thin silver/grey bezel visible around the screen; no brand logo or model sticker is legible anywhere in the frame.
No stand, remote, power cable, or ports are visible.
No ruler, tape measure, or size reference is present to confirm the stated screen size.
No view of the back panel, where a model/serial sticker would normally be found.

claims.evidence: No scale/measurement reference in photo 0; angle makes size estimation unreliable.
No logo, badge, or model plate visible on the bezel or frame in photo 0.
Screen is off in photo 0; no boot screen, home menu, or app icons shown.

claims.claim: TV is in working condition (implied by listing as a sellable smart TV)
claims.evidence: No photo shows the screen powered on; reflective black panel could be hiding cracks, dead pixels, or backlight damage.

risks.risk: Screen panel damage (cracks, pressure marks, dead backlight zones) hidden by reflective off-state glass.
risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the TV powered on, showing a full bright image or test pattern edge-to-edge.

risks.risk: Brand and model cannot be confirmed, which affects comparable pricing (Samsung vs generic/no-name panel).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the brand logo on the bezel and/or the model/serial label on the back panel.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/generic flat-screen TV, not as Samsung

risks.risk: Actual screen size may differ from the claimed 55 inch.
risks.proof: Photo of the TV with a tape measure across the diagonal, or back-panel label showing size/model.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest plausible size consistent with the photo's proportions, not 55 inch

risks.risk: Smart TV features (Wi-Fi, apps, OS) may be absent or non-functional.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the TV's home screen or settings menu showing smart OS and network connection.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (remote, stand, power cable) not shown, which affects usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of included accessories laid out next to the TV.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit with no accessories

proof_requests: Power on the TV and send a photo/clip of the screen showing a clear image (e.g., home menu or a bright scene) to check for panel damage and smart OS.
Close-up photo of the brand logo on the front bezel and the model/serial sticker on the back panel.
Photo of the TV with a tape measure across the screen diagonal to confirm actual size.
Photo of included accessories (remote, stand, power cable).
response.reason: The item is clearly a flat-screen TV, but no brand, model, size, power-on state, or smart functionality can be confirmed from the single off-screen photo, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, unbranded, untested flat-screen TV pending the requested proof.
